title: fix(hub): refuse invites accepted from an unverified email
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed
- Accepting an invite now requires a verified email on the session; an unverified one gets 403 `unverified_email`: "Verify your email address before accepting this invite."

## Verification
- `bun run check` passes; `bun run test` passes (690).
- The invite integration test accepts as an unverified user (refused with that message), then verifies the address and accepts (200). Without the fix the test fails.
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(hub): refuse invites accepted from an unverified email
